threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think that buskers in the tube are a joy rather than just another reason to avoid the station during strike chaos.
Caught the 35 last night; two guys were arguing over a half-eaten pizza. Turns out they were friends, just hard to tell in the dim light.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted a group of kids transforming a random sidewalk into an art gallery right before sunset - classic Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can grab a Döner and listen to live techno music at 3 AM, all while surrounded by graffiti art. It's a vibe that can't be found anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they navigate the BART delays—it's like a dance, while newcomers just look lost and frustrated.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy juggling in the rain while waiting for the 31. Muni pulls up right as he finishes—crowd goes wild. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but they miss the hidden plazas where locals chat over vermut. That's where the real magic is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their instinct to stand bewildered at every metro station map, while locals glide past without a glance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: When you stop holding doors for people at the station—it's a quick way to spot a newbie. Locals just glide past without a glance.
Last night on the 35, a guy serenaded the whole bus with a ukulele version of 'Wonderwall.' The driver just kept shaking his head, smiling.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I realized I was home? Walking past the corner shop, I saw a kid selling hand-painted rocks—genuine Neukölln hustle right there.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can hop on a tram after midnight and hear spontaneous karaoke from a group of friends. Only in Kreuzberg do everyday rides turn into impromptu concerts.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they know the taco truck schedules better than the Muni timetables. That’s dedication!

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: I saw a guy in a suit chase a runaway dog down Market St while trying to catch a bus. That pup really had him running!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think they can walk anywhere, but wait till they hit those steep streets after a few cervezas. It’s a workout just going home!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell recent arrivals by their confusion at the 'siesta' hours—still trying to shop or eat at 3 PM when everything's closed.
